messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Part 340010: firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we propose exactly that: our full need of 23400 pcs per year, bound for 24 or 36 months, at your standard 42-day lead time. The attached term sheets give the details.

Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a 10.1% volume increase, so this commitment secures steady, plannable load for your plant. Our bottom-up should-cost cost:340010 puts this seal at 24.31 EUR per piece, well below the quoted price.

As this exceeds the 2% approval limit, could you please submit it to your pricing committee for an authorised review? Could you also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010: firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have noted your should-cost calculation and the projected volume increase. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot is a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Due to our high plant utilization, a 42-day lead time is not feasible; 54 days is the earliest we can reliably confirm. For a 36-month commitment at 23,400 units per year with a 54-day lead time, we can offer a revised price of €31.90 per unit, with a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
